The organization offers a range of services designed to accelerate brand visibility, customer engagement, and overall business performance. By combining innovative digital tools with strategic planning, Stellar Media supports clients in navigating competitive markets and achieving sustainable growth. Team members have the opportunity to work with diverse brands and contribute directly to impactful, results-oriented marketing initiatives. Role Description The Medical Rep (indoor) at Stellar Media is a full-time remote role responsible for engaging healthcare-related clients and promoting digital marketing services tailored to medical and health brands. Day-to-day activities include handling inbound and outbound calls, responding to online inquiries, presenting service offerings, and explaining how digital strategies can support client growth. The role involves maintaining accurate records of client interactions, following up on leads, coordinating with internal marketing and sales teams, and supporting the development of proposals or presentations. The Medical Rep also monitors client feedback, helps resolve basic issues, and contributes insights to improve communication materials and outreach strategies. Qualifications Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain services clearly to healthcare professionals and administrative staff. Experience in customer service, inside sales, or client support, preferably within healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical services. Comfort with remote work tools and CRM systems, including accurate data entry and documentation. Basic understanding of digital marketing concepts and willingness to learn about campaigns, online branding, and lead generation. Ability to manage time effectively, handle multiple inquiries, and follow structured processes in a fast-paced environment. Relevant education in business, healthcare, marketing, or a related field is beneficial; prior medical representative or call center experience is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Graphic Designer
review_candidates.description: Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Graphic Designer role based in New Cairo. The Graphic Designer will create visual assets for digital and print channels, including marketing materials, social media content, presentations, and internal communications. Responsibilities include developing logos and brand identities, selecting and applying typography, and ensuring all designs align with brand guidelines. The role involves collaborating with marketing and product teams, translating briefs into clear visual concepts, and preparing final files for production or publication. The Graphic Designer will also manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and maintain a consistent, high-quality visual standard. Qualifications Strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with a portfolio demonstrating diverse visual work. Experience in Logo Design and Branding, including developing and applying brand identity systems. Proficiency in Typography, including layout, hierarchy, and legibility in digital and print formats. Advanced use of industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma or similar). Ability to interpret creative briefs, present design concepts, and incorporate feedback constructively. Excellent attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills in a fast-paced environment. Relevant academic background in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field is preferred. Understanding of basic digital marketing principles and asset requirements for web and social media is an advantage. Realestate experience is must
